title: Scenario 6: Malware Dropper Detection
description: Malware droppers create executable files in unusual locations like Temp, Public, or ProgramData folders. These are common staging areas for APT29 payloads.
hunt_for: File creation events (Sysmon Event ID 11) where executables (.exe, .dll, .ps1) are written to temporary or public directories.
kibana_query: EventID:11 AND TargetFilename:(*.exe OR *.dll OR *.ps1) AND TargetFilename:(*temp* OR *public* OR *programdata*)
detection_tips: Look for Sysmon Event ID 11 (File Creation)
Check directories: Temp, Public, ProgramData, AppData
Correlate with network connections from same process
key_indicators: Files created shortly after network activity
